prompt:
Create one standalone photorealistic photograph for Povod, a personal gift website. Use warm family documentary photography: observe a believable spontaneous moment, unforced expressions, and gentle natural imperfections. Newlyweds aged 30 and 34 stand close together just after a civil wedding ceremony, looking at each other with relieved joyful smiles. The bride holds a small seasonal bouquet; the groom wears a plain dark suit. Use a candid paired portrait outside a simple civic building in soft open shade, with relaxed hands and posture. Output a vertical 4:5 composition for a website cover. Keep the lower 20 percent visually quiet for an optional website caption; place no faces, hands, or key gestures there. Preserve generous space above and beside the subjects. All people are fictional and independently invented for this image; do not reproduce anyone from a reference. Give them ordinary everyday appearances, distinct faces, realistic skin pores, age-appropriate texture, and natural clothing folds. Use an understated contemporary Russian or European everyday context without national stereotypes. Use warm neutrals, paper cream, muted terracotta, and natural surrounding colours with believable exposure, without a heavy orange filter. References inform only photographic techniques and mood; create an original scene and composition. Keep faces, hands, and important gestures within the central 70 percent of the frame, with comfortable safe margins and anatomically correct fingers, limbs, eyes, and teeth. No readable text, letters, numbers, logos, branding, watermarks, captions, borders, collages, grids, or contact sheets. No plastic skin, exaggerated smiles, duplicated people, extra limbs, or distorted perspective.

Additional subject and framing requirements: The bride has a short straight black pixie haircut, dark eyes and a round face. The groom has short sandy-blond hair, a long narrow face, round wire-frame glasses, and no beard. Make their appearances ordinary and distinct. Exact vertical 4:5. Keep lower 20 percent quiet, with all hands above this area.

CORRECTION: Continuous real photograph from top to bottom. No gradient mask, fade, crossfade, dissolve, compositing, artificial blur band, or synthetic empty caption band. Any lower caption space consists only of normal clothing, furniture or scenery that belongs naturally to the real scene. The bride's skirt and the groom's trousers must continue naturally to the bottom of the image. No foreground ledge, table or horizontal divider cutting across their bodies. A normal continuous three-quarter portrait, with the quiet lower area made from their actual clothing.
review: Reviewed replacement full portrait: black-pixie-haired bride and clean-shaven blond groom with glasses outside civic building. Continuous ivory skirt and dark trousers extend naturally to image bottom; no synthetic foreground band, crossfade or mask. Bouquet-holding hands and faces coherent, lower fifth quiet clothing.
